answer: A karst of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
